Title: Isaiah's Signs to Ahaz
DateApprox: c. 735-732 BC (approx., during the Syro-Ephraimite crisis)
KeyPersons: Isaiah; Ahaz, King of Judah; Shear-jashub; Maher-shalal-hash-baz
Events: As Syria and Israel threaten Jerusalem, Isaiah meets Ahaz with his son Shear-jashub ('a remnant shall return'), offers a sign Ahaz refuses, and announces the Immanuel sign; Isaiah then writes on a tablet and names a second son Maher-shalal-hash-baz ('speed to the spoil'), a sign that Assyria will strip Damascus and Samaria.
